== Title ==
<span lang="ja">オード・マンテル</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja"></span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分のバウンティ・ハンターはここに－2で配備できる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Ord Mantell]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light box is blank. Dark text lets bounty hunters deploy here at -2, adding できる (may). One Light Force icon, one Dark Force icon, Planet, parsec 1.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-ordmantell-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Ord Mantell]].</ref>
